---
name: "nf-core/mmseqs_fasta_cluster"
description: "Subworkflow that generates a clustering TSV file from a set of amino\
  \ acid sequence within a FASTA file."
keywords:
- "fasta"
- "sequences"
- "cluster"
- "linclust"
- "mmseqs"
components:
- "mmseqs/createdb"
- "mmseqs/cluster"
- "mmseqs/linclust"
- "mmseqs/createtsv"
input:
- sequences:
    type: "file"
    description: "Fasta file containing sequences for clustering.\n"
- clustering_tool:
    type: "string"
    description: "Clustering algorithm of MMSeqs to use for cluster generation. Options\
      \ are 'linclust' or 'cluster'.\n"
output:
- seqs:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input FASTA file mapped to its corresponding clustering tsv,\
      \ per input entry."
- clusters:
    type: "file"
    description: "Clustering file mapped to its corresponding input FASTA file."
authors:
- "@vagkaratzas"
maintainers:
- "@vagkaratzas"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/mmseqs/createdb@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/mmseqs/cluster@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/mmseqs/linclust@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/mmseqs/createtsv@0.0.0-6d1763b"
